arxiv-2012-13287.title: Stability Analysis of Discrete-Time Linear Complementarity Systems
arxiv-2012-13287.creator: Arvind U. Raghunathan, Jeffrey T. Linderoth
arxiv-2012-13287.description: Abstract A Discrete-Time Linear Complementarity System (DLCS) is a dynamical system in discrete time whose state evolution is governed by linear dynamics in states and algebraic variables that solve a Linear Complementarity Problem (LCP). The DLCS is the hybrid dynamical system that is the discrete-time counterpart of the well-known Linear Complementarity System (LCS).

arxiv-2104-03772.title: (Integral-)ISS of switched and time-varying impulsive systems based on global state weak linearization
arxiv-2104-03772.creator: J.L. Mancilla-Aguilar, H. Haimovich
arxiv-2104-03772.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by J.L. Mancilla-Aguilar, H. Haimovich. It is shown that impulsive systems of nonlinear, time-varying and/or switched form that allow a stable global state weak linearization are jointly input-to-state stable (ISS) under small inputs and integral ISS (iISS). The system is said to allow a global state weak linearization if its flow and jump equations can be written as a (time-varying, switched) linear part plus a (nonlinear) pertubation satisfying a bound of affine form on the state.

arxiv-2110-08406.title: Surrogate- and invariance-boosted contrastive learning for data-scarce applications in science
arxiv-2110-08406.creator: Charlotte Loh, Thomas Christensen, Rumen Dangovski, Samuel Kim, Marin Soljačić
arxiv-2110-08406.description: Abstract Deep learning techniques have been increasingly applied to the natural sciences, e.g., for property prediction and optimization or material discovery. A fundamental ingredient of such approaches is the vast quantity of labelled data needed to train the model; this poses severe challenges in data-scarce settings where obtaining labels requires substantial computational or labor resources.

arxiv-2110-09690.title: Variability in extragalactic class I methanol masers: New maser components toward NGC 4945 and NGC 253
arxiv-2110-09690.creator: T. P. McCarthy, S. P. Ellingsen, S. L. Breen, M. A. Voronkov, X. Chen, H-h. Qiao
arxiv-2110-09690.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by T. P. McCarthy, S. P. Ellingsen, S. L. Breen, M. A. Voronkov, X. Chen, H-h. Qiao. We have used the Australia Telescope Compact Array (ATCA) to make new observations of the 36.2-GHz ( 4 − 1 → 3 0 4_{-1}\rightarrow 3_{0} E) methanol transition toward NGC 4945 and NGC 253. These observations have revealed the presence of new maser components toward these galaxies, and have provided the first clear evidence for variability in extragalactic class I methanol masers.

arxiv-2208-08532.title: Survey of Methods for Solving Systems of Nonlinear Equations, Part II: Optimization Based Approaches
arxiv-2208-08532.creator: Ilias S. Kotsireas, Panos M. Pardalos, Alexander Semenov, William T. Trevena, Michael N. Vrahatis
arxiv-2208-08532.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ilias S. Kotsireas, Panos M. Pardalos, Alexander Semenov, William T. Trevena, Michael N. Vrahatis. This paper presents a comprehensive survey of methods which can be utilized to search for solutions to systems of nonlinear equations (SNEs).

arxiv-2302-07310.title: Ion dynamic characterization using phase-resolved laser-induced fluorescence spectroscopy in a Hall effect thruster
arxiv-2302-07310.creator: Y. Dancheva, P. Coniglio, M. Da Valle, F. Scortecci
arxiv-2302-07310.description: Abstract Significant information on the dynamics of the plasma constituents in Hall effect thrusters can be obtained using minimally-intrusive techniques such as laser-induced fluorescence (LIF) diagnostics. Indeed, LIF provides an excellent tool to determine the ion velocity distribution function with high spatial resolution.

arxiv-2305-02093.title: Efficient Online Decision Tree Learning with Active Feature Acquisition
arxiv-2305-02093.creator: Arman Rahbar, Ziyu Ye, Yuxin Chen, Morteza Haghir Chehreghani
arxiv-2305-02093.description: Abstract Constructing decision trees online is a classical machine learning problem. Existing works often assume that features are readily available for each incoming data point. However, in many real world applications, both feature values and the labels are unknown a priori and can only be obtained at a cost.

arxiv-2307-15428.title: Implicit neural representation for change detection
arxiv-2307-15428.creator: Peter Naylor, Diego Di Carlo, Arianna Traviglia, Makoto Yamada, Marco Fiorucci
arxiv-2307-15428.description: Abstract Identifying changes in a pair of 3D aerial LiDAR point clouds, obtained during two distinct time periods over the same geographic region presents a significant challenge due to the disparities in spatial coverage and the presence of noise in the acquisition system.

arxiv-2309-09467.title: A Model of Stochastic Memoization and Name Generation in Probabilistic Programming: Categorical Semantics via Monads on Presheaf Categories Journal: Electronic Notes in Theoretical Informatics and Computer Science Volume: 3
arxiv-2309-09467.creator: Younesse Kaddar, Sam Staton
arxiv-2309-09467.description: Abstract Stochastic memoization is a higher-order construct of probabilistic programming languages that is key in Bayesian nonparametrics, a modular approach that allows us to extend models beyond their parametric limitations and compose them in an elegant and principled manner. Stochastic memoization is simple and useful in practice, but semantically elusive, particularly regarding dataflow transformations.

arxiv-2401-13359.title: Reconfigurable routing in data center networks
arxiv-2401-13359.creator: David C. Kutner, Iain A. Stewart
arxiv-2401-13359.description: Abstract A hybrid network is a static (electronic) network that is augmented with optical switches. The Reconfigurable Routing Problem (RRP) in hybrid networks is the problem of finding settings for the optical switches augmenting a static network so as to achieve optimal delivery of some given workload.

arxiv-2412-11371.title: Wavelength-Tunable and High-Heralding-Efficiency Quantum Photon Source in Birefringent Phase-Matched Lithium Niobate Waveguide
arxiv-2412-11371.creator: Qi-Tao Zhu, Xiao-Xu Fang, He Lu
arxiv-2412-11371.description: Abstract Lithium niobate (LN) is a birefringent material, where the strong birefringence thermo-optic effect is promising for the generation of quantum photon source with widely tunable wavelength. Here, we demonstrate birefringent phase-matching in a 20-mm-long waveguide fabricated on 5 μ \mu m-thick x-cut lithium niobate on insulator.

arxiv-2512-18593.title: From Scratch to Fine-Tuned: A Comparative Study of Transformer Training Strategies for Legal Machine Translation
arxiv-2512-18593.creator: Amit Barman, Atanu Mandal, Sudip Kumar Naskar
arxiv-2512-18593.description: Abstract In multilingual nations like India, access to legal information is often hindered by language barriers, as much of the legal and judicial documentation remains in English. Legal Machine Translation (L-MT) offers a scalable solution to this challenge by enabling accurate and accessible translations of legal documents.

arxiv-2512-21889.title: Long-term monitoring of repeating FRB 20220912A with the uGMRT at low radio frequencies Facilities: Giant Meterwave Radio Telescope, Khodad, Pune astropy ( 3 ) , matplotlib ( 25 ) , scipy ( 69 ) , your ( 1 ) , RFIClean ( 39 ) , PRESTO ( 60 )
arxiv-2512-21889.creator: Ajay Kumar, Yogesh Maan, Banshi Lal, Yash Bhusare, Shriharsh P. Tendulkar, Visweshwar Ram Marthi, Puja Majee
arxiv-2512-21889.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ajay Kumar, Yogesh Maan, Banshi Lal, Yash Bhusare, Shriharsh P. Tendulkar, Visweshwar Ram Marthi, Puja Majee. Some repeating FRBs exhibit occasional extreme repetition rates, but very few show a sustained high activity level. One such hyperactive repeater is FRB 20220912A, which was discovered by CHIME/FRB Collaboration on 2022 September 12. Here, we present results from a long-term monitoring campaign of FRB 20220912A using the upgraded Giant Metrewave Radio Telescope (uGMRT) in the frequency range from 300 to 750 MHz.

arxiv-2604-06905.title: Inverse problems for the spectral fractional Laplacian with inhomogeneous Dirichlet boundary data
arxiv-2604-06905.creator: Ravi Shankar Jaiswal, Pu-Zhao Kow, Suman Kumar Sahoo

arxiv-2604-21564.creator: Rodrigo Nogueira, Giovana Kerche Bonás, Thales Sales Almeida, Andrea Roque, Ramon Pires, Hugo Abonizio, Thiago Laitz, Celio Larcher, Roseval Malaquias Junior, Marcos Piau

britannica-1911-infante.title: Infante (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-infante.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-infante.description: Article 'Infante' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 14), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. child), a title of the sons of the sovereign of Spain and Portugal, the corresponding infanta being given to the daughters. The title is not borne by the eldest son of the king of Spain, who is prince of Asturias, Il principe de Asturias. Until the severance of Brazil from the Portuguese monarchy, the eldest son was prince of Brazil.

pmc-10617271.title: Idiopathic pulmonary haemosiderosis misdiagnosed as haemolytic anaemia: a case report
pmc-10617271.creator: Xueqin Ma, Changxi Ju, Xiaotong Liu, Ying Tian, Jing Wu, Yuanxiao Li
pmc-10617271.description: Idiopathic pulmonary haemosiderosis is a rare disease primarily affecting children. The condition is characterized by widespread bleeding from alveolar capillaries, resulting in symptoms such as haemoptysis, shortness of breath and iron deficiency anaemia. However, it is not a specific disease and sometimes can manifest solely as anaemia, which may be easily overlooked and misdiagnosed.

pmc-11334133.title: Extended thoracotomy for main pulmonary artery access: Two lung cancer cases
pmc-11334133.creator: Kazuki Hayashi, Yusuke Kita, Jun Hanaoka
pmc-11334133.description: This report details two cases of right upper-lobe lung cancer, of patients aged 62 and 56 years, requiring complex bronchoplasty and thoracoscopic surgeries. In both cases, owing to intraoperative complications, extended thoracotomies were performed to gain access to the right main pulmonary artery. The postoperative courses were uneventful, implying that this approach was safe.

pmc-11610280.title: Acute remote home monitoring of acutely ill patients with COVID-19: how Dutch home monitoring initiatives were organized during the pandemic
pmc-11610280.creator: Karin Smit, Rick T van Uum, Stella Rijks, Alma C van de Pol, Abeer Ahmad, Roderick P Venekamp, Frans H Rutten, Dorien L M Zwart, the Dutch General Practitioners Research Consortium
pmc-11610280.description: BackgroundAcute remote home monitoring of acutely ill patients with COVID-19 holds potential for early detection of deterioration and thus subsequentearly intervention that may prevent or mitigate progression to severe illness and need for respiratory support. Our aim was to describe common features of acute remote home monitoring programs for acutely ill patients with COVID-19 in the Netherlands.

pmc-12415387.title: Metabolic Syndrome Is Associated with the Prognosis in Elderly Critically Ill Patients with Acute Kidney Injury
pmc-12415387.creator: Xuelei Yu, Chenqiao Tang, Yuejun Hu
pmc-12415387.description: PurposeMetabolic syndrome (MetS) is linked to adverse outcomes in chronic diseases, but its impact on acute kidney injury (AKI) in elderly critically ill patients remains unclear. This study aimed to evaluate the association between MetS and 90-day mortality in this population.

pmc-12511407.title: Systematic over-expression of secondary metabolism transcription factors to reveal the pharmaceutical potential of Aspergillus nidulans
pmc-12511407.creator: Shuhui Guo, Lakhansing Pardeshi, Longguang Qin, Chris Y. Cheung, Xiaofeng Liu, Lu Fan, Chi Cheng Mok, Chirag Parsania, Zhiqiang Dong, Ben C. B. Ko, Kaeling Tan, Koon Ho Wong
pmc-12511407.description: Many life-saving drugs are derived from fungal secondary metabolites, and the rich diversity of these metabolites is a gold mine of bioactive compounds for drug discovery. However, the biosynthetic genes for most secondary metabolites remain transcriptionally silent in fungi, posing a significant bottleneck in their discovery.

pmc-12558325.title: Cerebrospinal fluid metabolomic and postpartum depression: A Mendelian randomization study
pmc-12558325.creator: Minping Hong, Qin Xu, Xiaowen Huang, Junyan Wang, Zhenyi Ma
pmc-12558325.description: Postpartum depression (PPD) is a multifaceted mental health disorder manifesting as enduring sadness, anxiety, and exhaustion following childbirth. Emerging evidence points to a metabolic dimension in its pathology. Our research examines the causal links between cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) metabolites and PPD via Mendelian randomization (MR).

pmc-12589608.title: Prenatal methamphetamine exposure induces oxidative stress and apoptosis in the ovaries of rat offspring
pmc-12589608.creator: Mozhdeh Ebrahimi, Nayere Zare, Batool Ghorbani Yekta
pmc-12589608.description: Methamphetamine abuse among women of reproductive age is a growing concern, necessitating investigation of its intrauterine effects on offspring. In this study, we examined the induction of oxidative stress and apoptosis in the ovaries of rat offspring following maternal methamphetamine exposure. Pregnant Wistar rats received methamphetamine (2 mg/kg or 5 mg/kg) from gestational day 10 until delivery.

pmc-12638933.title: Systemic PCSK9 elevation characterises autoimmune liver disease across sexes
pmc-12638933.creator: Patricia Mester, Vlad Pavel, Petra Stoeckert, Martina Müller, Hauke Christian Tews, Christa Buechler
pmc-12638933.description: Proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 (PCSK9) is a key regulator of serum cholesterol. Its expression is particularly abundant in hepatocytes, yet its role in autoimmune liver diseases remains unclear. Here we investigated serum PCSK9 levels in patients with autoimmune liver diseases and compared them to healthy controls, with attention to sex-specific differences.

pmc-12641469.title: Architecture-Independent Absolute Solvation Free Energy Calculations with Neural Network Potentials
pmc-12641469.creator: Anna Katharina Picha, Sara Tkaczyk, Thierry Langer, Marcus Wieder, Stefan Boresch
pmc-12641469.description: Allowing atoms or molecules to disappear is a critical step in alchemical free energy simulations (FES). The necessary tricks are well understood when using force fields. Over the past few years, neural network potentials (NNPs) have seen rapid development. Their potentially higher accuracy compared to force fields makes them attractive for use in FES.

pmc-12703701.title: Neuroinflammatory Mechanisms and Vocalization Biomarkers in the Pink1−/− Preclinical Model of Parkinson’s Disease
pmc-12703701.creator: Sarah A. Lechner, Cynthia A. Kelm-Nelson
pmc-12703701.description: Parkinson’s disease is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder with an unclear etiology and a long preclinical phase. The multitude of challenges of studying this in humans highlight the need for robust preclinical animal models that accurately reflect the disease’s preclinical progression.

pmc-13079825.title: An H3K14ub-H3K9me3 feedback circuit governs heterochromatin spreading and inheritance in fission yeast
pmc-13079825.creator: Takenori Toda, Junyao Zang, Hongyun Qi, Yimeng Fang, Peng Jiang, Chun-Min Shan, Jiemin Wong, Songtao Jia
pmc-13079825.description: Heterochromatin is a bistable chromatin state essential for genome stability and gene regulation. Its spreading and inheritance have long been explained by a “read-write” cycle in which histone methyltransferases bind pre-existing tri-methylation of histone H3 lysine 9 (H3K9me3) and propagate this mark to neighboring nucleosomes. However, the weak affinity and limited catalytic stimulation provided by H3K9me3 alone challenge this model.

pmc-13092585.title: Association and variation in performance, nutrient digestibility, carcass traits, and intestinal development of broiler chickens by various male-to-female ratios✰
pmc-13092585.creator: Motaleb Ebrahimi, Mohsen Daneshyar, Sina Payvastegan, Hamed Ahmadi
pmc-13092585.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Despite well-documented differences in growth performance and physiology between male and female broilers, incorporating varying male-to-female ratios into research designs offers a more industry-relevant framework, enhancing the applicability and translational value of experimental findings. The objective of this study was to determine the relationship and accurate estimate changes of performance, nutrient digestibility, carcass characteristics, coefficient of variation (CV) of performance, gut weight and length, and intestinal morphological parameters due to the use of different male-to-female ratios.

pmc-13201954.title: Presacral meningocele presenting after rupture into the retroperitoneal space with acute debilitating intracranial hypotension: illustrative case
pmc-13201954.creator: Mahnoor Shafi, Ryan Gensler, Yuanxuan Xia, Timothy F. Witham
pmc-13201954.description: BACKGROUNDPresacral meningoceles are rare congenital cystic lesions caused by herniation of the thecal sac through an anterior sacral defect. Presentations range from asymptomatic to rupture and meningitis. Treatment aims to eliminate subarachnoid communication, recurrence, and complications.OBSERVATIONSThe authors report the case of a 21-year-old female who developed acute, debilitating, positional headaches requiring flat bed rest.

pmc-13209756.title: Lignin-Derived N,S-Co-Doped Carbon Dots Enable Improved Mn2O3 Cathodes for Aqueous Zinc-Ion Batteries
pmc-13209756.creator: Jiahong Wang, Wenxuan Wang, Yimin Shi, Tai Peng, Daxin Liang
pmc-13209756.description: Aqueous zinc-ion batteries (AZIBs) are highly promising for large-scale energy storage applications owing to their distinct merits, such as exceptional safety, abundant zinc reserves, high ionic conductivity, and facile manufacturing. Featuring natural abundance, low cost, environmental benignity, and high theoretical specific capacity, Mn2O3 has emerged as one of the most competitive cathode candidates for AZIBs.

pmc-13383238.title: Baxdrostat versus osilodrostat: steroid biosynthesis in human adrenocortical cells
pmc-13383238.creator: Yuki Taki, Takashi Kono, Ikki Sakuma, Naoko Hashimoto, Masataka Yokoyama, Eiryo Kawakami, Takashi Miki, Hironobu Sasano, Yasuhiro Nakamura, Tomoaki Tanaka
pmc-13383238.description: To compare the functional selectivity of baxdrostat versus osilodrostat in primary human adrenocortical cells, focusing on aldosterone suppression while preserving cortisol biosynthesis, we conducted an experimental ex vivo study using primary cells derived from aldosterone-producing adenomas, cortisol-producing tumors, and normal adrenal cortex.

pmc-13474655.title: Time-dependent risk of sleep disorders in patients with epilepsy: a nationwide cohort study
pmc-13474655.creator: Seung Won Lee, Chaeyoon Kang, Unbi Choi, Hohyun Jung, Youngoh Bae

pmc-13493137.title: Complex dorsal metacarpophalangeal joint dislocation in a 15-year-old boy
pmc-13493137.creator: Rebecca Z Xu, Behdad Ravarian, Stephanie Mun Kim, Ryan Paul
pmc-13493137.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Surgery was required to reduce the joint and confirmed a complex MCP joint dislocation with trapped soft tissues that prevented reduction, known as a Kaplan lesion. Intraoperatively, the volar plate was seen to be interpositioned dorsal to the metacarpal head, and the head of the metacarpal was buttonholed in the volar palm fascia, with the flexor tendons trapped ulnarly and lumbricals radially. Postoperative radiographs confirmed concentric reduction of the MCP joint (Appendix 1, available at www.cmaj.ca/lookup/doi/10.1503/cmaj.251814/tab-related-content).
